name: Insert LEGO Brick (Single-Hand)
description: Insert a LEGO cap onto a fixed LEGO base; the base is taped to the table with 3M.
success_criteria: LEGO cap fully contacts the base and the base does not move.

name: Press Power Button (Single-Hand)
description: Press the power-strip button taped to the table; a connected lamp should toggle.
success_criteria: Lamp color/state changes after the press.

name: Twist Light Bulb (Bimanual)
description: Rotate the bulb to secure it into the socket.

name: Pack Cookies into Bag (Bimanual)
description: Open the bag and place the cookies inside.

name: Move Bottle Between Plates (Bimanual)
description: Pick the bottle from the left fixed plate and place it onto the right fixed plate.
success_criteria: Bottle ends on the right plate.
